name: Daily standup
description: Weekday mornings at 09:00: recent commits, current test-suite health, and calendar events for today and tomorrow, compiled into a standup note with suggested priorities. Each preparation step has an explicit failure notification. Point your workspace at a git project first.

args.title: ⚠️ Standup preparation failed
args.message: The standup note could not be prepared. Open Workflows → History for the failed step; no partial note is announced as ready.
